# Smile Habits OC

> Smile Habits OC is Orange County's comprehensive oral health education resource providing evidence-based dental care guidance across all life stages, from infancy through seniors, with multilingual accessibility and community health partnerships.

Smile Habits OC serves Orange County residents with free oral health education, dental service referrals, and resources for accessing affordable care through Medi-Cal and other programs. The organization is supported by Proposition 56 funding and partnerships with public health agencies.

## Key Topics

- Oral Health Education
- Cavity Prevention
- Tooth Decay Prevention
- Dental Care
- Orange County
- Medi-Cal Dental Program
- Oral Hygiene
- Life Stage Guidance (Infancy to Seniors)
- Water Fluoridation
- Sugary Beverages
- Dental Services Referral
- Community Health
- Special Health Care Needs
- Kindergarten Oral Health Assessment (KOHA)
- Prenatal Dental Care

## Getting Started

- [Home - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org): Homepage providing oral health education and family dental care resources.
- [Página Principal - Smile Habits OC](http://smilehabitsoc.org/es): Spanish language homepage for accessible oral health education.
- [Local Oral Health Program - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/local-oral-health): OC Local Oral Health Program providing resources for optimal oral health in Orange County.

## Life Stage Oral Health Guides

- [Infancy (0-11 months) - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/oral-health-information-infancy-0-11-months): Infant oral health care guide for ages 0-11 months and early tooth decay prevention.
- [Early Childhood (1-5 years) - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/early-childhood-1-5-years): Baby teeth health and oral hygiene guide for children ages 1-5 years.
- [School Aged-Children (6-13 years) - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/school-aged-children-6-13-years): Dental health and cavity prevention guide for school-aged children 6-13 years.
- [Adolescents and Young Adults (14-20 years) - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/adolescents-and-young-adults-14-20-years): Oral hygiene and dental care guide for adolescents and young adults 14-20 years.
- [Adults (21-64 years) - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/adults-21-64-years): Adult oral health habits guide for gum disease and tooth decay prevention.
- [Older Adults (65+ years) - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/older-adults-seniors-65-years): Dental care and oral hygiene guide for seniors 65+ years.
- [Pregnancy - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/pregnancy): Prenatal dental care and oral health guide for expectant mothers.
- [Individuals with Special Health Care Needs - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/individuals-with-special-health-care-needs): Oral health guide for individuals with physical or developmental disabilities.

## Oral Health Topics & Education

- [Oral Health Videos - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/oral-health-videos): Educational videos on dental care for all ages from infants to seniors.
- [Sugary Beverages and Oral Health - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/sugary-beverages-and-oral-health): Guide on how sugary drinks cause tooth decay and cavity prevention strategies.
- [Water Fluoridation - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/water-fluoridation): Information on water fluoridation benefits for cavity prevention and public health.
- [KOHA Resources - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/koha): Kindergarten Oral Health Assessment resources and California AB 1433 compliance info.

## Dental Services & Affordability

- [Find a Dentist - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/find-a-dentist): Find dental services and Medi-Cal coverage options in Orange County.
- [Paying for Dental Care - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/paying-for-dental-care): Guide to low-cost dental care options, Medi-Cal, and insurance programs.
- [Contact Us - Smile Habits OC](https://smilehabitsoc.org/contact-us): Contact form and Orange County Health Referral Line for dental services.
